messages.subject: plot limits and mapRegion
messages.body_plain:
If the default mapRegion always overrides xlim and ylim, what is the point of having them?

Whenever I try to set limits for the map plot, it ignores them and plots whatever it likes, based on the mapRegion (usually world).

Shouldn't the override be the other way around?

Since I know the exact limits of what I want to plot, it should allow me to plot on the limits I decide instead of limiting my options to 1 of 8 choices only: "eurasia", "africa", "latin america","north america", "uk", "oceania", "asia" or "world".

Please fix it asap.
Thank you very much.
